text: In 2019, parking amendments were introduced along Eunice Road to permit one-hour parking for patients destined for the medical building at 1100 Sheppard Avenue East. Since these amendment have been introduced, residents along Eunice Road have had persistent issues with illegal parking and issues with shared road space. The proposed recommendations rescind the permission for one-hour parking in order will help to address this road safety issue.

North York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the parking prohibition in effect at all times on the south and east sides of Eunice Road, between a point 69 metres east of Ambrose Road and Marcelline Crescent (south intersection). 2. Rescinded the one hour maximum parking regulation in effect from 8:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the south side of Eunice Road, between a point 15 metres east of Ambrose Road and a point 54 metres further east. 3. Rescinded the parking prohibition in effect from 4:00 p.m. of one day to 8:00 a.m. of the next following day, Monday to Friday and at all times Saturday and Sunday, on the south side of Eunice Road, between a point 15 metres east of Ambrose Road and a point 54 metres further east. 4. Prohibited parking at all times on the south and east sides of Eunice Road, between Ambrose Road and Marcelline Crescent (south intersection).
